{{Quote|Erils, those alien fuzzballs at the starport put us off schedule. Must have been the slowest loaders I've ever seen. Any chance of saving time in hyperspace?''"<br />"''Yes, but it increases the risk factor by .22 for a total of .35&hellip;''"<br />"''Which exceeds LMC policy and is therefore prohibited.|Captain [[Pricene]] and Erils|<ref name="FBS" />}}
'''Erils''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked for the [[Lant Mining Corporation]]. She was the [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] of [[LMC Hauler One-Six]], the lead ship of [[Convoy LMC-55c]], when it was captured by an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] and a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]].<ref name="FBS" />
